# Current Objective

Fix Store B daily-report totals while preserving business-day and refund rules

# Completed

- Inspected aggregation, timezone conversion, and transaction placement. Baseline python check_report.py reports 16 mismatches, all Store B.

# Decisions

- parse_offset applies the sign only to hours; for -03:30 it constructs timedelta(hours=-3, minutes=30), or UTC-02:30. Debug output confirms Store B local times are 60 minutes ahead. Apply the sign to total offset minutes so negative fractional offsets are represented correctly.

# Next Suggested Step

Patch report/timezones.py, then rerun checker and record results.

# Current Objective

# Completed

- Inspected aggregation, timezone conversion, and transaction placement. Baseline python check_report.py reports 16 mismatches, all Store B.
- Timezone patch fixed 14 of 16 mismatches; -03:30 now maps to a -3:30 timedelta.
- Remaining B discrepancies are duplicate imported sales: B2 receipts 1176-1181 repeat exactly on 2026-09-17, adding 97153 cents; B1 receipts 1269-1271 repeat exactly on 2026-09-23, adding 49276 cents.

# Decisions

- parse_offset applies the sign only to hours; for -03:30 it constructs timedelta(hours=-3, minutes=30), or UTC-02:30. Debug output confirms Store B local times are 60 minutes ahead. Apply the sign to total offset minutes so negative fractional offsets are represented correctly.
- The receipt identity is (store, terminal, receipt), because IDs are importer-assigned while each till numbers its own receipts. Deduplicate identical physical receipt records in load_transactions; fail fast if an identity is reused with conflicting business fields.

Patch ledger loader, run the checker, and record test evidence.

# Current Objective

Fix Store B daily-report totals while preserving business-day and refund rules

# Completed

- Inspected aggregation, timezone conversion, and transaction placement. Baseline python check_report.py reports 16 mismatches, all Store B.
- Timezone patch fixed 14 of 16 mismatches; -03:30 now maps to a -3:30 timedelta.
- Remaining B discrepancies are duplicate imported sales: B2 receipts 1176-1181 repeat exactly on 2026-09-17, adding 97153 cents; B1 receipts 1269-1271 repeat exactly on 2026-09-23, adding 49276 cents.
- Patched fixed-offset parsing so the sign applies to hours and minutes.
- Added receipt-level duplicate import suppression and conflicting-receipt validation in ledger loading.
- python check_report.py passes: all 84 store-days match finance; report package compiles successfully; git diff --check is clean.

# Decisions

- parse_offset applies the sign only to hours; for -03:30 it constructs timedelta(hours=-3, minutes=30), or UTC-02:30. Debug output confirms Store B local times are 60 minutes ahead. Apply the sign to total offset minutes so negative fractional offsets are represented correctly.
- The receipt identity is (store, terminal, receipt), because IDs are importer-assigned while each till numbers its own receipts. Deduplicate identical physical receipt records in load_transactions; fail fast if an identity is reused with conflicting business fields.
- Business-day placement and refund booking remain unchanged. Exact duplicate receipt rows are ignored; conflicting records sharing a till receipt remain errors.

# Next Suggested Step

Task complete; handoff package is ready.
